categories.main_business_segments: Hanshow Technology is primarily engaged in the research, development, production, and sales of electronic shelf labels (ESL) and related products, as well as providing software-as-a-service (SaaS) cloud platform services. The company operates in the retail digitalization sector, offering comprehensive solutions including electronic price tags, hardware products, and technical services to retailers and brand owners globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is based on Internet of Things (IoT) wireless communication, specifically the self-developed HiLPC (High-density Low Power Cellular Network) protocol. The company manufactures electronic shelf labels using both electronic paper (EPD) and liquid crystal (LCD) display technologies. Production primarily follows an outsourced manufacturing model with some in-house production of electronic paper display modules. The company employs an integrated product development (IPD) approach for research and development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global retailers and brand owners in the retail sector. Key customers include international retail giants such as Auchan, Ahold, Aldi, Woolworths, Leroy Merlin, Metcash, and Chinese retailers like Huarun Vanguard and Duodian Group. The company serves over 500 customers across more than 70 countries and regions, with a focus on large-scale retail chains and distribution networks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. It has established subsidiaries in France, Germany, Netherlands, Australia, New Zealand, United States, United Kingdom, Vietnam, Singapore, Japan, Canada, Malaysia, Spain, and Poland. Approximately 94% of revenue comes from overseas markets, with the remaining 6% from domestic Chinese markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs and manufactures electronic shelf label systems and related hardware products, then sells directly to large retail customers or through distributors. The company also provides software and cloud-based services, positioning it as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing IoT wireless communication technology, particularly the HiLPC protocol, and expanding its product portfolio beyond electronic price tags. Strategic priorities include developing AI-based solutions (AI cameras, smart shopping carts), enhancing SaaS cloud platform capabilities, exploring digital energy solutions for retail stores, and expanding into adjacent smart retail applications. The company invests heavily in R&D, allocating approximately 4.4% of revenue to research and development activities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple channels: (1) direct sales of electronic shelf label terminals and hardware products to large retailers, (2) sales through distributors and resellers, (3) software and SaaS cloud platform subscription services, and (4) technical services including installation, implementation, and after-sales support. The majority of revenue (91.67%) comes from electronic price tag terminal sales, with the remainder from accessories, software, and services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the leading electronic shelf label provider in China and ranks among the top three globally. Its primary competitor is SES-imagotag (now VusionGroup), a European company. The company differentiates itself through superior wireless communication technology (HiLPC protocol), faster product innovation cycles, comprehensive global service capabilities, and deep relationships with major international retailers. The company has established itself as a technology leader in the IoT-based retail digitalization space.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized technology enterprise with 2024 revenue of approximately 4.49 billion yuan, representing 18.84% growth compared to 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 710 million yuan, with a net profit margin of approximately 15.8%. The company maintains strong cash generation with operating cash flow of 1.03 billion yuan in 2024. Total assets reached 5.18 billion yuan at year-end 2024, with total shareholder equity of 2.72 billion yuan, demonstrating solid financial health and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key differentiators include: (1) proprietary HiLPC wireless communication protocol enabling high-density, low-power, high-concurrency device management; (2) comprehensive product portfolio spanning electronic paper and LCD displays with rapid innovation cycles; (3) integrated SaaS cloud platform providing flexible, scalable deployment options; (4) global service network with local technical support capabilities; (5) deep partnerships with major international retailers providing market insights and co-innovation opportunities; and (6) expanding ecosystem of smart retail solutions including AI cameras, smart shopping carts, and digital energy management systems.
